scripts.dev: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ajay --only firestore,auth,storage,functions --ui "npm run seed && node scripts/dev-session.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-ajay --only firestore,auth,storage,functions
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w scripts && npm run typecheck -w functions
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ajay --only firestore,auth,storage,functions,hosting --ui "npm run seed && node scripts/wait-forever.mjs"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ajay --only firestore,functions "node --import tsx --test functions/test/callables.test.ts"
